//permissions: Cloud-night safety envelope (platform-guards model; advances #86). Pre-allows the Workflow tool. RUNTIME REALITY (re-probed 2026-06-04): the native Workflow launcher is NOT enabled in the cloud context (Claude Code on the web / Routines), so the canonical cloud execution path is SPEC-ORCHESTRATION -- the nightly Routine reads .claude/workflows/conformance-hub.js as the canonical SPECIFICATION and executes its three stages via read-only Explore agents (the script's exact stage prompts + schemas; Sonnet verifiers, Opus skeptic/digest). Each nightly run ATTEMPTS the native launcher first and falls back to spec-orchestration -- a free nightly re-probe; the digest reports which path ran, and execution swaps back to native automatically when the platform re-enables it. The Workflow allow is retained for local sessions (where the launcher works) and for that cloud re-enable. NO Write/Edit deny is committed by design: deny beats allow with no path carve-outs, so a blanket deny would break BOTH local daily work and the routine's own digest write. Cloud subagent containment is instead provided by platform guards -- Routines push only to claude/* branches, every run lands in a PR (no auto-merge), the conformance review is read-only by design (schema-bound agents that never write), and the Routine prompt runs a post-run `git status --porcelain` tripwire reported in the PR/digest.
